facts.fact: Paratus says its 840 km Botswana Kalahari Fiber, completed in 2022, links Gaborone to the Equiano landing station in Namibia, giving Botswana its first express fibre route to Europe.

Paratus Botswana says it has fibre routes out of Botswana, two into South Africa and one into Namibia, which links to the Equiano subsea cable at Swakopmund, with a fourth route to Zimbabwe and Zambia still being lit.

facts.fact: Botswana Daily News reports that on 29 May 2024 Paratus Botswana launched the 840 km Botswana Kalahari Fibre from Mamuno to Lobatse, completing the Trans Kalahari route that connects Botswana to the 144 Tbps Equiano cable at Swakopmund in Namibia.

Paratus Botswana says its 840 km Botswana Kalahari Fiber route from the Namibian border to Lobatse was activated at the end of March 2024, connecting Botswana to the Equiano subsea cable landed in Namibia.

note: Only a gateway-competition level; states no route or capacity sale.
